ينفصم (form VII)
# يَنْفَصِمُ (yanfaṣimu) /jan.fa.sˤi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# يَنْفَصِمَ (yanfaṣima) /jan.fa.sˤi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# يَنْفَصِمْ (yanfaṣim) /jan.fa.sˤim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
